notes.title: Boss Fight & Chapter Conclusion │ Early Access V0.23
notes.notes: [p][b]It's Finally Here[/b][/p][p][/p][p]With this update, all the base content for [b]Chapter 1[/b] of [b]Terminal Error[/b] has been completed. Although there are still mechanics, aesthetics and elements of the game that need some touching up, the flow and structure of the Chapter are all finally in place![/p][p][/p][p][b]What To Expect?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Fight our new boss, the [b]Sample,[/b] in a strategic battle and escape the intimidating monster as it chases you throughout the crumbling ruins of Site 41. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/8020df5ece6c0b9520f35ca33960d909994dc033.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This boss fight is our attempt at throwing in some exciting FPS elements to spice up the Point-and-Click experience to create a truly unique challenge for Players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c7ec0a4263f3f6e60f9869304667c4d4f442dfa7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can also expect the new Administrative Block to be fully operational, now with new interactions and sections. Explore the various offices and areas as you figure out how to reach the Sample and fix this mess.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/f1f784ef6a6f9e9f4a42c47a1bc971c504c720c2.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/aa0a129dc002b5e1123cdce7e9cadea77d4ae9cb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank y'all for sticking with Terminal Error for so long! Our vision for the game, and specifically Chapter 1, has finally taken shape. But we're not done yet! The next few months will be spent refining mechanics, tidying up loose threads and polishing Chapter 1 before we label this portion of the game a completed.[/p][p][/p][p]We aim to have Chapter 1 fully done up before the end of the year, with aims of getting a decent bit of Chapter 2 out by the first quarter of 2026.[/p][p][/p][p]If you've stuck around this long, we're sure y'all will enjoy this new update! The progress we've made and changes we've done throughout these past months has really been something! We hope y'all will continue to support and spread word of our strange and experimental game with all horror and thriller enthusiast who don't mind a little puzzle solving and Point-and-Click nostalgia!!![/p]

notes.title: Boss Fight Developments│Devlog #6
notes.notes: [p]We've started work on our boss fight, building an arena, setting attack patterns and creating a challenging experience for Players to mess around with. So what can you expect?[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Sample[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The source of the strange flesh-like infection spreading around Site 41, the Sample is a chunk of flesh that quickly takes on a monstrous form. Snaking around the arena, it carefully searches for any targets to kill. Your goal is to to move through the winding pathways and destroy the [b]Acid Pouches[/b] hanging overhead to do some real damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/401cdb94ebaefa465d701bebdcf5b237e7ed7290.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/78fc813ceefcc63d80f1c4ec9f6196ae8915ffa1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our battle then progresses into a chase where you have to escape the reaches of the Sample as it eagerly tries to catch you[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/5fa17fc8f1695af72be89848d48460fc7a515b57.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/dc5ea972a0a4a30fe4d4b5757bda8b7c5cc31c75.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]When Will It Be Ready?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Right now, the Boss Fight is still a while away from completion. Animations, graphics, glitches and other kinks still need to be ironed out before we can pump out this version. Our current aim is to finish up with the boss fight as well as tidying our earlier puzzles and maps by mid September.[/p][p][/p][p]Working on this game has been a long and difficult process, by the game is improving and progressing more and more each day![/p][p][/p][p]For those who have stuck around with us, we have many interesting and exciting things in store for you! And, thank y'all for your support despite out slow progress![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update│Early Access V0.21
notes.notes: [p][b]We're Making Progress![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Since our last build, we felt that we wanted to go further with the game and take the time to make a truly outstanding experience. After months of hard work, we've finally firmed up the mechanics, aesthetics and gameplay of Terminal Error. Although this portion of the game is not yet complete, we have made great strides, creating something we believe is exceptional![/p][p][/p][p][b]So, What's New?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We've expanded the world. Moving out of the Guardhouse, explore [b]The Tunnel[/b], the entrance to the military facility Site 41. Infected by the same flesh-like disease spreading in the Guardhouse, navigate this dangerous space while figuring out how to contain this disaster and get out safely...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/33218bcd3d09af3d49a67ad593523ea852492317.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Be careful though, you're being hunted...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/bbb9cafbb6c0c1385912306c0829513cd3916d14.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fresh New Maps[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Inspired by Brutalist architecture, the new maps come with an oppressive and imposing atmosphere, weighing down on you as you sneak through the eerie corridors and try to avoid whatever is stalking you...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/56ddd52316925e0bc24906d81547dcf2db7d1d57.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c64a82af10b6bc1cee1e4f35039d93824007196a.png"][/img] [/p][p]Also expect the grotesque sight of flesh, spreading and infecting the facility as you carefully traverse through it...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/b8ca5172687580059dd082c819faa350e010032a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fresh New Puzzles[/b][/p][p][/p][p]More puzzles and more types of puzzles. We've added a wide array of challenges to overcome. The Terminal Puzzle, Electrical Box and Gear Box are just a few of our exciting  new additions...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/3afcc5dbc8e9938a10263d5b8e882e4d2ee94d47.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c8f12bd9e1a372b106f3e735e06352beb31b6fe0.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/51c3e7c57223ef81e46aa4d038b893737c2039a1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, we have new gadgets and interactable objects to mess around with and use throughout the game[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/54a184c7ff0f74520bacf0e708c1e8ce91e8ee0e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the tip of the iceberg[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fresh New Graphics[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As you might've noticed, the shader has also been improved to better fit our unsettling world and add to the horror mystery feeling...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/3bfb44ca9d65e559283d7fc36b325e1404942b77.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]More graphics and animations have also been added throughout to set the mood and better draw you in to the surreal world of Terminal Error[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/512594c3dbf7734f9f9e0958df74b6f98b9b7e70.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fresh New Tutorial?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Even the Tutorial has been touched up, now with improved puzzles and a more refined experience. We have really made huge changes, making the moments more impactful and setting the stage for the world and it's larger plot...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c8adddbae7a8235ac78e6925420f650e87c4cec1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/38f5c7e82f089fc3f70245e1d598acd3a8aecb3b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The initial monster encounter has also changed... Just a little...[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/d861632b4abbaf799cc4e61b0c84916fc68195b3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We've worked tirelessly on trying to make this gaming experience something truly special. Although our schedule has been rocky, we'll keep pushing through to make an exceptional game. At our heart, we're gamers like everyone else and simply want to make the best horror thriller game we can.[/p][p][/p][p]Luckily, updates should be coming slightly more often in the foreseeable future. Expect another significant update or two by the end of 2025. We'll also be adding more devlogs where possible to keep everyone updated on our progress, but no promises on how often![/p][p][/p][p]As for localisation and translations, we are still awhile away. As the script and text keep changing, we will only be hopping over to other languages nearer the end of the development cycle. But do not worry! We are committed to bringing Terminal Error to you, so just give us time![/p][p][/p][p]For those who have stuck with us from the start, we really appreciate your support and we want to assure everyone that we aren't quitting until this game in finished and up to the standard we want! We look forward to the feedback and building the best game possible![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/a927dc96abe99105ed8dcd8f2a43850ed7da167a.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Early Access V0.2
notes.notes:
[b]New Map and Minigames[/b]

In the newest update, we've added in the The Tunnel. The area is filled with more minigames and areas to explore, building off the general gameplay of the Tutorial.

However, due to time constraint, we were not able to perfect the AI and mechanics for our Monster and thus chose not to put it in just yet. We have been working tirelessly to make the game and are hoping to fully complete the Monster as well as this area by the end of December.

[b]Minigame Showcase[/b]

Here is just a short look at some of the minigames we've introduced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/25440243e8c0e3b02de1e0ef9517ed099a6b2039.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/49510c5d98e717aed975c2e0bd3c5c879461c5c7.png[/img]

[b]Map Showcase[/b]

And here are some shots of the larger map in general

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/e87a4794abd58ef731f88f9335b00c34011bb896.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/26b3c7ababaa458a657d3b5962be326e1f283f1e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/e9444b24e828528722218e28db293a404a4da3eb.png[/img]

[b]Future Plans[/b]

The next part we have in store after tidying up the map, minigames and monster is to introduce the first boss fight for the game. We're currently looking at completing this in Quarter 1 of 2025.

More importantly, we would like to hear more constructive feedback from the community to improve the gameplay and overall experience. In particular, we would like to hear the pain-points and deeper issues Players feel so that we can rectify them and strengthen the game-loop.

If you would also like to reach out to us, feel free to contact us on our X/Twitter where we are more active! We really want to create the best experience possible and are excited to hear from the Players!

notes.title: New Update, New Map on the way│Devlog #5
notes.notes:
[b]What Do We Have In Store?[/b]

We've been working on the next major update for a while now, and we're getting close to pushing it out there. Currently, we have a massive new map, new minigames and most importantly, monster encounters and interactions in store. This will build off the concepts of the tutorial level and upgrade it to a larger, more dynamic world. 

[b]A Whole New World[/b]

The map we've been working on is nearly complete for now, so here's a little peak into some of what we've been working on...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/2c1e9f1d25ab2a00c842ce07bf2b8db148d91a8b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/9f80bef1063d1f5f979684199f2714bc289a14b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/6805df6fc01d8abf25b7a543699e76d9294580b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/d9064ce4b009db262927a8c7019c3d0b6e992dee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/30c128665b6ddc8e9c210caa142082e661c0dc2b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/8b02207b2888010d0bd998fea6b7dcba6be5cfef.png[/img]

We'll be releasing more images and updates on our progress in the coming weeks, so stay tuned!

[b]We Need Feedback![/b]

Also, we would really appreciate any feedback for the next part! It's quite a bit more content and we would love to hear more Player comments! We're just two brothers working on this game together... the team is small, and our resources are limited. Because of this, there might be bugs and issues we may have overlooked along the way. As such, feedback is the best way for us to fix and improve our game along the way.

notes.title: Early Access Release│Early Access V0.1
notes.notes:
[b]It's Finally Here![/b]

Terminal Error V1.0, is officially out! Currently, this version only contains the tutorial and introduction stage. With slightly less than an hour of gameplay, it's a quick glimpse into the surreal world of Terminal Error. 

[b]Join us![/b]

This is where you come in! Due to the experimental nature of our game, we really need the community's feedback to build a better and more refined product. If you have any bugs to report, issues to raise, or suggestions to give, PLEASE let us know in our Steam Discussions for the current version! Our aim is to create the best possible horror experience with your help!

[b]Future Plans?[/b]

The tutorial and introduction are not yet complete! We have a monster and fight sequence planned, but due to time constraints, were not able to add in. It will likely take another few weeks for it to be completed, so stayed tuned for that update real soon. And of course, this is only the beginning. We have many more maps and many more monsters in store...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/f6f3eb1ea235dffe13f0ace69f73053b0bed8876.png[/img]

notes.title: Mechanics Overhaul│Devlog #04
notes.notes:
[b]We're Still Alive![/b]

It's been awhile since we've done an update, but don't worry! We're still hard at work on the game!

We've been tirelessly refining to the Concept, Mechanics and User Interface of Terminal Error, and the game is finally taking on it's final form. Stay tuned to our more frequent updates in the coming weeks, but for now, you'll have to settle for a quick look at our more polished Point-and-Click elements!

[b]Minigames, Dialogues and Movement[/b]

To start off, we've streamlined the minigames, splitting them into layer stages for Players to go through. You'll find objects to observe, items to pick up, posters and notes to look at and even devices to tinker around with in our new and improved minigame system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/11932057edd48ab4e04ccf6a2e64854485414015.gif[/img]

Alongside improving the minigames, we've also touched up on the dialogue aesthetic and taken much time to make it cohesive with our new overworld interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/678e52309b372c512d3a9e154916d39d40ff73f8.gif[/img]

Lastly, we've starkly changed the 'looking around' mechanic since our Demo. We found the 360 movement to be quite messy and often times troublesome. As such, we've opted to replace it with a clearer and more straightforward turning system, allowing Players to focus on a few curated camera positions for each standpoint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/052abbc81f1c9cdd30a029854ec0bd37173c3eec.gif[/img]

Terminal Error has really come a long way since we first started, and it's really exciting that the game is taking on a truly unique shape now! We sincerely hope to push out our [b]Early Release Before Halloween[/b] this year, so please stick around!!!

notes.title: Doors, Doors and More Doors│Devlog #03
notes.notes:
[b]Movable Doors[/b]

Just a minor update, but we've created movable doors! The over world will be decorated with small intractable items like this (such as cabinets, light switches and many more!), not only as a way to spice up the maps but to also add to the experience. In the case of the doors, items can be hidden behind them, and other intractable will likely have other functions tied to them (like turning a device on or off).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/73ca3757a37a91b12ca595aeb3e026bf43f1f7ca.gif[/img]

We'll be be working harder on mechanics in the coming weeks, so look forward to that!

notes.title: New Environments│Devlog #02
notes.notes:
[b]New Maps[/b]

Playing around with our lighting, shaders and world, we've come up with some new haunting maps to share. Currently, we are working on the administrative areas, building desolate and oppressive work spaces. The areas might change, but I think we've got the vibe down!

[b]Guardhouse[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/525fb81e733233ef305018a72c21d9d0a3bb2327.png[/img]

Acting as the starting area, find your way out of the unsettling guardhouse and figure out what tragedy has befallen the base.

[b]Lounge[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/aad512a5d34b426234ea86ebd3d837992e8a94ae.png[/img]

Usually bustling with life, the lounge is now left eerily empty. A large and spacious area, the room is littered with furnishing and a beautiful blue theme. 

[b]Office Hallway[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/28b42a77c0606cb2d5d059fc5b12eafe9af9bd6f.png[/img]

Made out of a catacomb of claustrophobic halls, sharp turns and confusing pathways, explore the labyrinth-like office space. If you're lucky, you won't find any monsters waiting for you behind every corner.

[b]Electrical Room[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/31fbd4125e65a81d217b3214a34e05b1f3116143.png[/img]

Controlling the flow of energy in this entire floor, the electrical room is cluttered with systems and wires. If you can shut it down, perhaps you can descend further into the facility.

Our maps are far from complete, and this is only a fraction of what we have in store! Next round, we're aiming to release some content either or our minigames or the monster itself!

Stay tuned :)

notes.title: PC-98 Throwback│Devlog #01
notes.notes:
[b]Interface Update[/b]

Inspired by PC-98 styled frames and interfaces, we've taken their layout and brought it to another level. With elements of Sci-fi infused in it, we've invented our own experimental aesthetic interface. With key functions such as accessing items, checking the world map, using the gun and many others incorporated into our interface, it will be a huge focal point in our gameplay!

[b]Overworld UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/80d67a710bb95986dae07dbe8dc7dab326181b8d.png[/img]

Explore the eerie world of Terminal Error with the help of your trusty gun and map. And don't forget, if you ever need help, just use the radio...

[b]Minigame UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/03c2f608cb039a0424e3db6ec972970c97355467.png[/img]

Find the missing parts, put the pieces together and solve the puzzles that block your way as you delve deeper into the facility...

[b]Inventory UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/bf1a6d992153a516e4311ae3eeb29bc7757820d1.png[/img]

If you have the time, why not inspect your items and figure out what they do. Some of them might be more useful than you think...

[b]Settings Menu UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/0daf678a307a32f486a9a161fe30bc77bd1087be.png[/img]

And of course, tinker with out settings to engineer the best possible experience for yourself...

Right now, this is what we've done up, but look forward to more improvements in our interfaces as we continue to work on Terminal Error.
